name: sangeet
description: Sangeet (संगीत) — a production-ready Indian music streaming & discovery web app

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
